title.narrative: Field Study-Bangladesh: Mothers Infants and Lactation Quality(MILQ) Project

description.narrative: EARLY-MILQ (E-MILQ) STUDY TO COLLECT AND ANALYZE HUMAN MILK DURING THE FIRST MONTH POSTPARTUM - THE ONGOING MILQ STUDY HAS SUCCESSFULLY COLLECTED COLOSTRUM (AT 2-3 DAYS POSTPARTUM) AND THEN BREAST MILK FROM 1 MONTH THROUGH 8.5 MONTHS POSTPARTUM. MILK SAMPLES WERE NOT COLLECTED DURING THE FIRST MONTH BECAUSE OF INVESTIGATOR'S CONCERN THAT ADDING MILK COLLECTION (ACCOMPANIED BY A GREAT DEAL OF ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON MOTHERS AND INFANTS AS COLLECTED AT ALL VISITS) DURING THE FIRST FEW WEEKS AFTER BIRTH WOULD RESULT IN UNACCEPTABLE RATES OF REFUSAL TO ENROLL AND EARLY DROP-OUTS DURING THIS STRESSFUL PERIOD. HOWEVER, SAMPLE COLLECTION FROM 1 TO 8.5 MONTHS HAS PROCEEDED EXCEPTIONALLY WELL WITH FEWER DROP-OUTS THAN EXPECTED AT ALL FOUR SITES. AT THIS TIME THE INVESTIGATORS BELIEVE THAT WE COULD ADD A FOLLOW-ON, SEPARATE STUDY OF MILK COMPOSITION AND VOLUME BETWEEN BIRTH AND 1 MONTH POSTPARTUM, AND THAT THIS WOULD BE WELL-ACCEPTED BY PARTICIPANTS.
